archetypes.name: dyn-temp-root-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: Report-token artifacts now have mixed preserve/delete lifecycle paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed report_tokens_cli.py and report_tokens_render.py lifecycle paths. Focus on whether advertised cache and plot paths remain readable after CLI exit, while pre-advertisement failures remove their temp roots. Check error-path preservation around post_issue failures and render(temp_root=None) atexit cleanup. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
